d: Duchess ELENA comes from her palace with NINETTA and DANIELI, greeted with awe by the Sicilians
The people are in danger of melting together at this moment.
BÉTHUNE appears with soldiers. He submits a letter to ARRIGO
The Cabinet of Guy de Montfort in Palermo
ARRIGO is introduced by two pages
One hears of the singing. On stage girls braiding wreaths
ARRIGO occurs without first noticing ELENA
